crossRefs.note: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the…
concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly…

translations.web: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest.
translations.bsb: But if the raw flesh changes and turns white, he must go to the priest.
translations.kjv: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
translations.asv: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, then he shall come unto the priest;
